answers.expected_answer: Retrieval-Augmented Generation combines dense vector retrieval and sparse keyword search to fetch relevant document context passed to an LLM for grounded answer generation.
DocMind AI combines dense semantic embeddings with BM25 sparse lexical search and unifies both ranked lists via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).
Reciprocal Rank Fusion uses a smoothing constant of k=60.
DocMind AI uses BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 producing 384-dimensional dense embeddings.
The Cross-Encoder (ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2) evaluates token-level query-chunk interactions to rerank top candidate chunks.
DocMind AI prioritizes Google Gemini as the default LLM provider and automatically falls back to Groq LPU inference on error.
Russell and Norvig define AI around intelligent agents that perceive their environment, learn from experience, and act to maximize a performance measure.
Machine Learning enables computer programs to improve performance at a task through experience.
A computer program learns from experience E with respect to task T and performance measure P if its performance at T measured by P improves with E.
Traditional ML relies on human-designed features, whereas Deep Learning learns hierarchical features and mappings directly from raw data.
